title: Hagar and Ishmael
description: Sarai gives her Egyptian female slave Hagar to Abram. Hagar becomes pregnant and flees from Sarai into the desert, where the angel of the Lord meets her at a spring and promises her numerous descendants. She returns and gives birth to her son Ishmael.
